summary: Verified the Atlas emotion motion/animation system end-to-end. All 5 seeded motion presets apply the correct class on the featured .visit-bubble, all keyframes are declared, Web Animations API reports every core/aura/particle animation as playState='running' with the correct animationName, and rAF-synchronised transform samples confirm the animations are progressing frame-by-frame in the real browser. Overlay open/close (X, Escape, backdrop) all work. 196 bubbles render. .motion-still CSS rule exists with an animation declaration. Motions are working correctly — the earlier user report of 'motions don't seem to work' cannot be reproduced.

web_animations_api.radiate: core=motion-radiate-glow running, aura=motion-radiate-aura running, particles(8)=motion-radiate-rise running
web_animations_api.pulse: core=motion-pulse-beat running, aura=motion-pulse-aura running, particles(8)=motion-pulse-ping running
web_animations_api.panic: core=motion-panic-jitter running, aura=motion-panic-prickle running, particles(8)=motion-panic-particle running
web_animations_api.heavy: core=motion-heavy-bob running, aura=motion-heavy-aura running, particles(8)=motion-heavy-fall running
web_animations_api.breathe: core=motion-breathe-core running, aura=motion-breathe-aura running, particles(8)=motion-breathe-orb running

verification_details.motion_still_css_rule: .motion-still .visit-bubble-core { animation: 6s ease-in-out 0s infinite normal none running motion-still-breath } — present.
verification_details.transform_progression_via_rAF: panic-jitter core transform ticks: (1.47,-0.12) → (0.12,1.88) → (0,0) → (-1.86,3.86) → (-2.82,4.82) → (1.05,0.94) over ~2s window, currentTime advanced from 40ms → 2389ms. Animations are actively progressing.
verification_details.placeholder_visit_gate: canVisit predicate in EmotionDetailPanel.js correctly gates on source!=='placeholder' && name!=='Unnamed'. Verified by code review; the test cell (2,2) turned out to be a named cell so it did show the button — that's expected behaviour, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Note for future testers: headless Chromium (via Playwright) does not tick the CSS animation compositor clock while a JS `await new Promise(setTimeout)` is pending inside page.evaluate — animation.currentTime stays at 0 and getComputedStyle(transform) returns the base value. To observe animation progression you MUST advance frames via `requestAnimationFrame` between samples (or set anim.currentTime manually). This is a testing artifact, not a product bug.

The `.motion-still` particle keyframes reference `var(--angle)` on `.visit-particle`, which is defined in a shared block. Confirmed via getComputedStyle that --angle resolves (e.g. `calc(0 * 45deg)`), so particles animate correctly. No action needed.
index.css is ~1770 lines and growing. Consider splitting motion presets into a dedicated /styles/motions.css to keep the main stylesheet under 700 lines (soft guideline).
seed_data_creation: None — static site, all data from emotions.json.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When verifying CSS animations in Playwright headless Chromium, do NOT sample transforms via setTimeout — use `await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r))` between samples, or set `anim.currentTime` manually. Otherwise transforms appear frozen at the base value even though playState='running'. All 5 seeded motions (radiate/pulse/panic/heavy/breathe) at coords (4,4)(6,6)(-5,5)(-3,-5)(5,-5) are correctly wired end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Original user report ('motions don't work') is NOT reproducible after the main agent's fixes. In the current build: (a) the correct `motion-<preset>` class is applied on `.visit-bubble` (data-testid confirmed for all 5 seeded coords), (b) each of core/aura/8 particles has the correct running Web Animation with the expected animationName, (c) rAF-driven transform samples show progression across frames matching the keyframe values. Any residual perception of 'no motion' in a live browser would only occur if the OS/browser has prefers-reduced-motion: reduce enabled — the app's media query at index.css line 1028 kills all featured-bubble animations in that case, which is intended behaviour.
